fusions.name: Flicked Brine
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of brine at the first enemy in front of you for 7 water damage and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Breakwater
fusions.desc: Raises a low reef 5 tiles long for 5 seconds. It deals 11 water damage to each enemy that crosses it and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to roll off and back onto whoever inflicted it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Calm Waters
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.8 health a second, permanently.
